Use this template to link to the [http://mkv25.net/dfma/ Dwarf Fortress Map Archive] in a simple manner. The first param is {{tt|m}} for maps, {{tt|mv}} for movies, the second one is the file number, and the third one is the link name.

{{tt|{{tl|dfma|m|1000}}}} -> {{dfma|m|1000}}<br/>
{{tt|{{tl|dfma|mv|1000|Best Movie Ever}}}} -> {{dfma|mv|1000|Best Movie Ever}}
